ideas.title: Pictures you can walk around
ideas.critique: Placing Lumi's pictures in the meadow is The gallery again, and a tool judging or misreading the island's output is We wrote PIE. What is new is that a depth model turns a photograph into a 3D relief that friends can walk round, which is a real picture-to-world loop. The wrongness from the model's guesses has to show in the geometry, or it reads as more scenery.

ideas.title: Lumi walks like its friends
ideas.critique: Lumi's own body language changes with its real social history, and the friends copy it. That is a persistent, slow rule rather than another event, and nothing posted does it. It is hard to show in a still, and the walks may all look similar to a viewer. Gait work also touches the goal-6 motion measures.

ideas.title: Seeing in depth
ideas.critique: The depth model's heat-map view over the live picture is a one-off visual gag. It resembles the other model-in-the-loop stunt (PIE) and works as a timed event that then ends. It is striking for 30 seconds but changes nothing about how the island works.

ideas.title: The fractal tree
ideas.critique: A slow persistent structure that grows from the island's history is close to Paths we wore and to the permanent-scenery form. Using a real fractal rule and the lace it leaves is a distinct look that suits path tracing. Posting it session after session risks repeating the same picture.

ideas.title: Morning reading
ideas.critique: A daily gathering where friends react to a cue is the same recipe as the heart, Yesterday and the other Lumi-led set pieces. The reactions to names are predictable gags. Reading the real journal aloud is the only new part, and it is mostly audio.

ideas.title: Wrong-way day
ideas.critique: A world-rule change applied to the whole island for a stretch is Slow time and Rewind in a bigger form. Mirroring the sun and reversing the words is a strong, readable premise. It is still an event that happens and then ends.

ideas.title: A friend who builds too
ideas.critique: Another maker, with its builds accumulating around the island, is more places and props of a kind the island has. Friends judging the builds echoes the crabs judging in Cannonball!. The comic crookedness is charming but expected.

ideas.title: The island's heartbeat
ideas.critique: Turning the real event rate into a pulse in sound and ground is a permanent background layer, close to The island plays itself. Ripples through the grass and pond give it a visible side. A thump can be ignored, and a film will not show it well.

ideas.title: Lost and found
ideas.critique: Leftovers that persist and are later reclaimed are more props of a kind the island has. The joy when a friend finds its hat is a small gag payoff. It ties to existing events but adds no new way the island works.

ideas.title: Postcards from the friends
ideas.critique: Daily traced pictures with a line from each friend are a feature of Lumi's pages, close to the gallery and the posts themselves. The friends as authors is a nice twist. It is a feed of stills, not a change to the island, and it would run into the posting rules.
